description: Correct dictated names, brands, acronyms and identifiers using the user's lexicon. Call before acting on a message with garbled proper nouns, spoken filler or run-on sentences; no permission needed. Use `output` as the message; mention corrections only when they affect your action. Only per-term hit counters change. Protects code, paths, URLs and emails (unless the lexicon's settings.skipCode is false). Never invents terms; call suggest_canonical for remaining garbled names. Text over 1000000 characters is refused, nothing checked. Below that, only the first 100000 characters are checked and matching stops after 1000 ms; when either limit is hit the result carries `incomplete` { reasons, checkedChars?, totalChars, note } and the unchecked text is returned as it was. Returns { output, changed, replacements, summary }, plus a `note` when `text` is empty or only whitespace; when `changed` is false the text was already correct and you should carry on silently (except with dryRun: true, where nothing is applied, so `output` is the input and `changed` is false even when `replacements` lists corrections: read `replacements` for what a real call would fix), unless the result also carries `skippedProject`: then this repo has a project lexicon that is not trusted yet, so tell the user once that `lexicon trust` (or `npx @ashlr/lexicon trust`) would enable it.

dryRun.description: When true, report candidate replacements without applying them: `output` is the input, `changed` is false even when `replacements` is not empty, and no hit is recorded.

minConfidence.description: Override the minimum confidence (0..1) a fuzzy or phonetic match needs. Omitted: the lexicon's settings.minConfidence, else 0.82. An exact alias or canonical match scores 1 and passes any value, except one the text spells with a word break the term does not have ("open ai" for OpenAI), which scores 0.95 and is refused above that.

text.description: The dictated or transcribed text to correct: at most 1000000 characters (longer is refused), of which the first 100000 are checked.

name: normalize_transcript
title: Normalize dictated text
